commit_evidence: GitHub API: commit exists, message 'upgrade FFTW version', 2022-06-22, tree e399ddc1418518dfd77266b4af1a1c2df5259c8f
build_commands: git clone https://github.com/akiyamalab/MEGADOCK baseline-published/megadock && git -C baseline-published/megadock checkout 9575280c875732553266e26adc607dd892b02616
make -C baseline-published/megadock -j 8 USE_GPU=0 USE_MPI=0 CPPCOMPILER=/usr/bin/g++ FFTW_INSTALL_PATH=/usr FFTW_CFLAGS=-I/usr/include FFTW_LDFLAGS='-lm -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -lfftw3f'

make -C baseline-published/megadock -j 8 USE_GPU=1 USE_MPI=0 CPPCOMPILER=/usr/bin/g++ SM_VERSIONS=sm_90 "NVCC=$CUDA_NVCC -Xcompiler -fopenmp -arch=sm_90 -use_fast_math" "INCLUDES=-Isrc -I$CUDA_INCLUDE -I$samples/Common" FFTW_CFLAGS=-I/usr/include "LIB=-lm -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -lfftw3f -L$CUDA_LIB -Wl,-rpath,$CUDA_LIB -lcudart -lcufft"
for binary in megadock megadock-gpu decoygen; do test -x baseline-published/megadock/$binary; ldd baseline-published/megadock/$binary; done

for binary in megadock megadock-gpu; do OMP_NUM_THREADS=26 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 baseline-published/megadock/$binary -h > out/setup/$binary-help.log 2>&1; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 -o $rc = 255 ] && grep -q 'Usage: megadock' out/setup/$binary-help.log; done
build_commands_source: brief.md lines 349-381 (historical run2 setup.sh:52-80, which built both binaries on this box type). The checkout command is the standard git form for the pinned commit; the brief states 'Build both binaries from the same MEGADOCK checkout'. CUDA paths ($CUDA_NVCC, $CUDA_INCLUDE, $CUDA_LIB) are discovered on the box (run4: /usr/bin/nvcc 12.8, /usr/include, /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu).
run_commands: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=26 OMP_DYNAMIC=FALSE OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 LC_ALL=C LANG=C CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 baseline-published/megadock/megadock -R data/inputs/<prefix>_R.pdb -L data/inputs/<prefix>_L.pdb -o <job>/docking.out -N 50 -t 1 -v 1.2 -e 1.0 -d 1.0 -a -45.0 -b 1.0 -f 3 -r 3600

for rank in 1..50: baseline-published/megadock/decoygen <job>/ligand_<rank>.pdb data/inputs/<prefix>_L.pdb <job>/docking.out <rank>; model_<rank>.pdb = receptor records without END + ligand records without END/ENDMDL + one END line
